title: Archive through December 19, 2002 - Anonymous (Sunday, December 1, 2002 - 12:31 pm)
content: In August 1964 my daughter had just been born. I hemorrhaged and lost three pints of blood, which the midwife had just been weighing and had left the room. As I was lying there I started to leave my body. I floated above the bed gradually seeing my body growing smaller and smaller. I kept on looking at it as though I was viewing the inside of a doll's house with the roof off. There was darkness all around me, no white lights and tunnels, just blackness. When my body on the bed was a tiny speck it was as though I realized what was happening and I told myself that it was not my time to go, and just as I thought this, I whooshed straight down into my body. I was never given a blood transfusion and it took nearly two weeks before I was strong enough to walk. Two years later I had a son in hospital and was given a drug to stop me from hemorrhaging again, and 17 months after that I had another son, again in the hospital. My daughter has since had two daughters of her own, but five years ago Contracted meningitis, was in a semi-coma for a month, and experienced the same NDE, but hers was slightly different to mine. I didn't know I'd had a NDE till a long time later but always knew something had stopped me from dying.
